import json, random, subprocess, time, os
random.seed(1)
C,E,K,F=8,4,5,8
def rnd(n): return [random.randint(-128,127) for _ in range(n)]
model=dict(classes=C,embedding_dim=E,
    length_embedding=[rnd(E) for _ in range(16)],
    gap_embedding=[rnd(E) for _ in range(16)],
    kernel=K, conv_weights=[[rnd(2*E) for _ in range(K)] for _ in range(F)],
    conv_bias=[random.randint(-2147483648,2147483647) for _ in range(F)],
    conv_shift=[random.randint(0,16) for _ in range(F)],
    dense_weights=[rnd(F) for _ in range(C)],
    dense_bias=[random.randint(-2147483648,2147483647) for _ in range(C)])
cfg=dict(slots=4,window=16,idle_timeout=10**12,len_quantum=100,gap_quantum=10,
    rate_num=1,rate_den=1,bucket_capacity=512,initial_tokens=512,pending_capacity=512,
    lanes=4,service=[1,1,1,1,1,1,1,1],fallback=0,time_edges=[0],count_edges=[0],
    probability=[[65536]])
conns=[dict(id="a",slot=0,label=0,split="dev")]
N=20000
packets=[dict(time=i,connection="a",length=random.randint(0,65535),draw=0) for i in range(N)]
doc=dict(version=1,config=cfg,model=model,connections=conns,packets=packets)
data=json.dumps(doc).encode()
print("input bytes",len(data))
t=time.time()
p=subprocess.run(['python3','submission/main.py'],input=data,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
dt=time.time()-t
print("rc",p.returncode,"time",round(dt,2),"outbytes",len(p.stdout),"stderr",len(p.stderr))
o=json.loads(p.stdout)
print("jobs",len(o["jobs"]),"packets",len(o["packets"]))
